question: Which component shows the large spike at layer 13-14 reaching approximately 1000 Max Activation Value?
model_answer: Based on the figure, the **ffn_residual** component (represented by the solid red line) exhibits the large spike at layers 13-14, reaching approximately 1000 Max Activation Value. This spike is notably higher than the activation values of the other two components (attn_output and attn_residual) at those layers.  The other lines remain relatively flat during this period.
